verdict.rationale: Decagon's blog discusses MCP as a standard way to package and expose tools. It also describes an infrastructure layer to curate, scope, and evaluate how tools are used, which implies the agent can consume MCP-exposed tools. However, this comes only from a blog post, not product docs showing users connecting their own MCP servers. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of adding or configuring external MCP servers, details on supported transports and authentication, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
